args.query: Pellow Home Living Covey & Lark rename

args.subject: PHL label confusion: Pellow Home Living vs Covey & Lark
args.body:
Hi June,

A note on the PHL label confusion on the Coastal side:

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark Retail on 16 Feb.
- "PHL" is also used for Pellucid Harbor Logistics (the Gulf Coast terminal rows), so the acronym alone is ambiguous.
- A saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals". It needs relabelling to Pellow Home Living so people stop searching under the old name.

Could you check whether any other saved reports or exports on the deal desk side still use the Covey & Lark name?

Thanks,
Sofia

args.subject: PHL label cleanup
args.body:

A note on the PHL label confusion on the Coastal side:

Could you check whether any other saved reports or exports on the deal desk side still use the Covey & Lark name?
